cases.text:
These notes concern separate situations unless I explicitly connect them.

Book me a window seat on the earliest flight from Bucharest to Vienna next Tuesday.

Please rename every file in the reports folder that ends in .tmp so that it ends in .bak instead.

Send Maria the slides from yesterday's meeting, but don't cc anyone from the sales team.

Remind me to call the dentist tomorrow at 9 a.m., and again an hour later if I haven't marked it done.

Order two large pizzas, one vegetarian and one with extra cheese, and have them delivered to the office.

Cancel all my meetings on Friday afternoon except the one with the investors.

Archive the emails from last quarter, but keep the ones that are flagged as important in the inbox.

Tom thinks the server crashed because of a memory leak, but I'm not convinced.

My manager told me that the project would be cancelled unless we found a sponsor.

Maria asked whether anyone had seen her keys.

I am frustrated by how many unrelated details I have to keep track of.

Which of these requests can be handled now, and which need clarification?

List the unresolved questions before taking any action.

These notes concern separate situations unless I explicitly connect them.

Nobody except Ana has access to the production database.

The report wasn't late because of the data team; it was late because of the holidays.

I never said I wouldn't come.

Not all of the guests have confirmed, but none have cancelled.

A tenant may terminate the lease with thirty days' written notice.

Refunds are available within 14 days of purchase, provided the item is unused.

Employees who work more than forty hours per week are entitled to overtime pay.

No personal data may be transferred outside the EU without the customer's explicit consent.

The warranty does not cover damage caused by water or by unauthorised repairs.

Children under twelve must be accompanied by an adult at all times.

I am annoyed about the delay, not about the person helping me.

Can you identify any conflicting requirements in these notes?

Point out contradictions rather than resolving them without asking me.

These notes concern separate situations unless I explicitly connect them.

Well, basically, the server is running now.

I think the small model is probably enough.

Maria says that the benchmark failed.

Not every user has access.

Exactly three workers are active.

If the signature is valid, the system accepts the file.

Normally reject the request unless an administrator approves it.

Which model has the lowest latency?

Do we know whether the test passed?

Could you check whether the tests pass?

Can Luna run on this hardware?

I am relieved that we are finally making progress, but I am still impatient.

What should be checked first, and why?

Give me a short ordered checklist and leave unrelated tasks independent.
